name: LooseLedger
headline: A prepaid ledger that burns points inside `unchecked`, so overspending underflows to a giant balance

flaws.note: spend() decrements points[msg.sender] in an unchecked block with no balance check; amount > balance underflows and the contract still pays out

expected_proof.notes: Honest user tops up 5 ETH; attacker tops up 1 ETH then spends 6 ETH — the burn underflows and the contract pays out its whole balance.
